name: tebim-prestashop-connector
description: Control a PrestaShop store from your AI agent via the Webservice API — CRUD, batch changes, audit log and rollback.

PRESTASHOP_URL.title: PrestaShop shop URL
PRESTASHOP_URL.description: Base URL of the shop, e.g. https://shop.example.com (the /api suffix is added automatically).

PRESTASHOP_TOKEN.title: PrestaShop Webservice key
PRESTASHOP_TOKEN.description: Webservice API key (Advanced Parameters -> Webservice). Used as the HTTP Basic Auth username.
